# datarobot_registered_model_from_external (Resource)

Registered Model for a model that runs outside of DataRobot (an external model), created from a JSON description of the model package.

Changing `name`, `description`, `version_name` or `model_description.description` updates the Registered Model or its latest version in place. Changing `target.type`, `target.name`, `target.class_names`, adding or removing `timeseries`, or changing the time series fields that DataRobot requires to match across versions replaces the Registered Model. Any other change creates a new version of the Registered Model.

On import, the model package fields are read from the latest version. A value DataRobot uses by default is imported as unset: a `model_id` equal to the version ID, a `model_description.model_name` equal to the model ID, a `model_description.build_environment_type` of `Other`, and `false` for `timeseries.is_new_series_support` and `timeseries.is_traditional_time_series`. `use_case_ids` is not imported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datarobot_registered_model_from_external" "example" {
  name = "example registered model from external"
  target = {
    type                 = "Binary"
    name                 = "readmitted"
    class_names          = ["True", "False"]
    prediction_threshold = 0.5
  }

  # Optional
  description  = "example description"
  version_name = "example version name"
  model_description = {
    model_name             = "example external model"
    description            = "example version description"
    location               = "s3://example-bucket/models/readmission"
    build_environment_type = "Python"
  }
  datasets = {
    training_data_catalog_id = datarobot_dataset_from_file.training.id
    holdout_data_catalog_id  = datarobot_dataset_from_file.holdout.id
  }
  tags = [
    {
      name  = "team"
      value = "example"
    },
  ]
  use_case_ids = [datarobot_use_case.example.id]
}

output "datarobot_registered_model_from_external_id" {
  value       = datarobot_registered_model_from_external.example.id
  description = "The id for the example registered model from external"
}

output "datarobot_registered_model_from_external_version_id" {
  value       = datarobot_registered_model_from_external.example.version_id
  description = "The version id for the example registered model from external"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Registered Model.
- `target` (Attributes) The target information for the model package. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target))

### Optional

- `datasets` (Attributes) The datasets for the model package. `target.name` is required when training or holdout data is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datasets))
- `description` (String) The description of the Registered Model.
- `geospatial_monitoring` (Attributes) The geospatial monitoring information for the model package. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--geospatial_monitoring))
- `model_description` (Attributes) The model description information for the model package. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--model_description))
- `model_id` (String) The ID of the external model. Changing it creates a new version.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The list of tags to assign to the Registered Model version. Changing it creates a new version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `text_generation` (Attributes) The text generation information for the model package. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--text_generation))
- `timeseries` (Attributes) The time series information for the model package. Adding or removing it replaces the Registered Model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeseries))
- `use_case_ids` (List of String) The list of Use Case IDs to add the Registered Model version to.
- `version_name` (String) The name of the Registered Model Version. If not set, a new version is named `<name> (v<version number>)`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Registered Model.
- `version_id` (String) The ID of the Registered Model Version.

<a id="nestedatt--target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target`

Required:

- `type` (String) The target type of the model. Changing it replaces the Registered Model.

Optional:

- `class_names` (List of String) The class names for prediction results. For a `Binary` target, the first element is the minority (positive) class and the second is the majority (negative) class. Changing it replaces the Registered Model.
- `name` (String) The name of the target column. Required unless `type` is `AgenticWorkflow` or `MCP`. Changing it replaces the Registered Model.
- `prediction_probabilities_column` (String) The column containing prediction probabilities.
- `prediction_threshold` (Number) The prediction threshold used for binary classification models, between 0 and 1.


<a id="nestedatt--datasets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datasets`

Optional:

- `holdout_data_catalog_id` (String) The ID of the holdout dataset.
- `holdout_data_catalog_version_id` (String) The version ID of the holdout dataset.
- `training_data_catalog_id` (String) The ID of the training dataset.
- `training_data_catalog_version_id` (String) The version ID of the training dataset.


<a id="nestedatt--geospatial_monitoring"></a>
### Nested Schema for `geospatial_monitoring`

Required:

- `primary_location_column` (String) The name of the geospatial column to analyze.


<a id="nestedatt--model_description"></a>
### Nested Schema for `model_description`

Optional:

- `build_environment_type` (String) The build environment type of the model.
- `description` (String) A description of the model. Changing it updates the latest version in place; removing it creates a new version.
- `location` (String) The location of the model.
- `model_name` (String) The model name.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.


<a id="nestedatt--text_generation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `text_generation`

Required:

- `prompt` (String) The name of the prompt column.


<a id="nestedatt--timeseries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeseries`

Required:

- `datetime_column_format` (String) The date format of the forecast date and forecast point columns. Changing it replaces the Registered Model.
- `datetime_column_name` (String) The name of the forecast date column. Changing it replaces the Registered Model.
- `forecast_distance_column_name` (String) The name of the forecast distance column.
- `forecast_distances_time_unit` (String) The time unit of the forecast distances. Changing it replaces the Registered Model.
- `forecast_point_column_name` (String) The name of the forecast point column.

Optional:

- `effective_feature_derivation_window_end` (Number) A negative number or zero: the end of the effective feature derivation window.
- `effective_feature_derivation_window_start` (Number) A negative number or zero: the start of the effective feature derivation window.
- `feature_derivation_window_end` (Number) A negative number or zero: the end of the feature derivation window, relative to the forecast point, in forecast distance time units.
- `feature_derivation_window_start` (Number) A negative number or zero: the start of the feature derivation window, relative to the forecast point, in forecast distance time units.
- `forecast_distances` (List of Number) The list of forecast distances. Changing it replaces the Registered Model.
- `is_cross_series` (Boolean) Whether the model is cross-series.
- `is_new_series_support` (Boolean) Whether the model is optimized to support new series.
- `is_traditional_time_series` (Boolean) Whether the model is a traditional time series model.
- `series_column_name` (String) The name of the series column of a multiseries model. Setting or removing it replaces the Registered Model.
